title: Movie replacement recovery hotfix
summary: Fixes movie recovery getting stuck when Jellyfin groups movies into collections. The highlights below are included from v1.15.0.
highlights: Jellydash can reconnect a deleted movie to its replacement when saved TMDB or IMDb identity confirms a single match. Review older title-based suggestions in Settings > Movie replacements.
Replacement groups keep their original History records and use current artwork. Settings supports Undo, Keep separate and Check again, with conflict checks for stale actions.
History keeps previously measured watch time across long polling gaps. Playback Reporting imports preserve library information and report uncertain legacy matches as conflicts instead of guessing.
Movie Statistics cards and History drilldowns agree across equivalent item ID formats, including conflicting replacement mappings.
Password resets revoke existing sessions and remembered logins. Live widgets stop retrying after sign-in expires. If you are updating from before v1.15.0, you may need to sign in again once.
